Third-party library: wordcloud2.js
Author: Tim Guan-tin Chien and contributors
Source: https://github.com/timdream/wordcloud2.js/tree/gh-pages/src
License: MIT (see LICENSE)

The project uses the upstream browser build locally for word placement and
shape packing. The application supplies its own data, colors, interaction,
and page styling. No request to GitHub is made while the app runs.
